title: Reviewer findings
description: What the review job's model emits. Run metadata (PR, head and base SHAs, mode) is not here: the poster takes it from the gate, never from the model. Neither is the verdict: the poster derives it from the findings, risk and the low-risk rules.

summary.description: Two to five sentences in plain team voice: what the PR does, and what a reviewer most needs to know about it.

findings.description: New findings at the reviewed head. On a re-review, only findings not already in priorFindings.

priorFindings.description: One entry per finding in context/prior-findings.json. Empty on a first review.

reviewMdSuggestions.description: Lines to propose for the repo's REVIEW.md when feedback revealed a gap in its bar. The bot never edits the file.

id.description: B<n> for blockers, F<n> for follow-ups, N<n> for nits. The poster renumbers ids that collide with prior findings or don't match the level.

path.description: Repository-relative path at the head SHA, as in the diff (src/x.ts, not pr/src/x.ts).

endLine.description: Last line of a multi-line range.

evidence.description: A quote from the code, or the reasoning that proves the failure.

needsRun.description: Only a local run could settle this claim.
